source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(out), len(out[0])
    rows = {r for r in range(h) if grid[r][0] == 1 or grid[r][w - 1] == 1}
    cols = {c for c in range(w) if grid[0][c] == 1 or grid[h - 1][c] == 1}
    for r in rows:
        out[r] = [1] * w
    for c in cols:
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][c] = 1
    return out
'''
